notes: Verbless לוּלֵי clause read with Jehovah as predicate (MACULA glosses '[it.were].Yahweh'): 'If ... not' to the particle, construction-supplied 'had been' to the name under rule 20, impersonal 'it' added, written שֶׁ takes 'who'. Competing reading: treat the English as a cleft of the הָיָה clause and mark 'it had been' one added unit headed on 'been'; rejected because the relative clause is a direct rendering of a written שֶׁהָיָה, not a cleft the ASV built around a simple Hebrew clause.
'on ... side' for the לְ is a fixed recasting with no word realizing the lexeme, headed on 'side' (rule 24); the suffix keeps 'our'.
